name: Salmon Typhoon
affiliation_detail:
Assessed as Chinese state-affiliated based on targeting patterns and tooling.  No specific PLA unit, MSS bureau, or contractor has been publicly identified. No indictments. 
CrowdStrike (2018) described Maverick Panda as "a China-nexus targeted intrusion adversary." Microsoft (2924) characterized Salmon Typhoon as "a sophisticated Chinese state-affiliated threat actor."
description:
Salmon Typhoon is a suspected Chinese state-affiliated espionage group active since at least 2007, primarily targeting U.S. defense contractors, government agencies, and cryptographic technology companies. The group is defined by its Sykipot (Wkysol) backdoor and focus on the U.S. defense industrial base, with additional targeting of aerospace, automotive, electronics and telecommunications. (Trend Micro, 2013)
After apparent inactivity, Salmon Typhoon showed renewed interest in 2024 when Microsoft and OpenAI documented the group probing LLMs for information on sensitive geopolitical topics, high- profile individuals, U.S. global influence, and technical translation — as well as attempting to use AI for malicious code generation.

campaigns.name: Defense Industrial Base Espionage
campaigns.description: CrowdStrike and Trend Micro documented targeting of U.S. aerospace and defense contractors using Sykipot backdoor via spear- phishing with DoD-themed and government-themed lures. Targets included civil aviation sector and broader defence industrial base.

campaigns.name: LLM/AI Probing Activity
campaigns.description: Microsoft and OpenAI documented Salmon Typhoon's exploratory use of LLMs for gathering information on sensitive geopolitical topics (U.S. influence, internal affairs, high-profile individuals), technical translation of computing terms, and attempted malicious code generation (blocked by AI safeguards). Represented renewed activity after dormancy. All accounts disabled.
